status: Offline comparison artifact; this script does not change production settings.

protocol.margin: log(absolute margin + 1) * 2.2 / (2.2 + winner adjusted Elo difference * 0.001); ties use 2.2 * log(2)
protocol.outcome: Win=1, tie=0.5, loss=0. The model estimates expected score, not a separate three-outcome distribution.
protocol.selection_metric: Mean cross entropy against 1/0.5/0 outcomes; lower is better. This is not a win/tie/loss likelihood.
notes: Forecast each game before applying its result.
Validation ratings learn from earlier validation results chronologically, with frozen settings.
Only the calibration-selected candidate and predeclared baselines are scored on held-out seasons.
Published parameter baseline uses our approved 1500 initialization and league center, not original historical initial ratings.
